official_slogan_en: Measured where measured. Reconstructed where necessary. Never invented.
official_slogan_nl: Echt gemeten. Echt gereconstrueerd. Geen verzinsels.

core_vision.sealed_house: Original RAW/CFA + capture metadata remain immutable measurement evidence.
core_vision.new_house: Latent Scene Truth / Scene Master is a separate reconstructed state and is not constrained by arbitrary source-container representation limits.
core_vision.representation_boundary: Representation can exceed the source. Knowledge claims cannot exceed the evidence.
core_vision.full_physical_role: FULL_PHYSICAL is an evidence/certification scope, not an architectural permission boundary.

zero_line_truthrange.zero_line: T=0 is a chosen positive-light reference/gauge L0; it is not sensor black, absolute darkness or clipping.
zero_line_truthrange.calibration_role: Calibration places evidence and uncertainty on the coordinate; it does not define the permitted ceiling/floor of the master address space.
zero_line_truthrange.iso_role: ISO/gain is immutable capture provenance and source-model state, not reconstructed-scene identity.
zero_line_truthrange.high_censor_rule: WhiteLevel clipping yields a finite TruthRange lower bound with upper=+infinity unless narrowed by valid additional evidence/model support.
zero_line_truthrange.dark_rule: Noise-limited darkness may yield lower=-infinity with a finite evidence-dependent upper bound; exact zero light is not inferred from noise alone.
zero_line_truthrange.dual_coordinate_rule: Keep signed scene-linear reconstruction and positive-light TruthRange as distinct companion coordinates.
zero_line_truthrange.permanent_boundary: The axis can be infinite. The evidence is finite. Reconstruction beyond evidence remains reconstruction.

zero_line_v0_1_validation.source_domain: HONOR BKQ-N49 BnCam tele 22.48mm f/2.6 4080x3072 BGGR
zero_line_v0_1_validation.next: Bind TruthRange to exact Stage-2/Latent Scene Master plus backend uncertainty and replace the provisional ISO*exposure proxy where stronger measured gain mapping exists.

tele_uncertainty.policy: Do not retune frozen v5.0g on the black/white-dog holdout.

apk_policy: FROZEN_NON_CANONICAL_SIDE_EVIDENCE; no APK-derived canonical changes unless user explicitly reverses policy.
next_scientific_work: Integrate portable source-bound v5.0g measured-role anchor extraction and exact real-DNG OpcodeList2/GainMap decoding.
Study/validate missing-channel demosaic topology before any reconstructed-channel uncertainty is called topology-certified.
Model camera-RGB covariance/off-diagonal dependence before propagating uncertainty into XYZ/colorimetric Scene Master.
Continue independent physical tele calibration and high-ISO uncertainty generalization review.
legal_license_policy: No open-source LICENSE is added unless the user explicitly chooses one.

self_gauge.L0: deterministic quantile of positive uncensored scene evidence

zero_line_v0_2_latent_binding.claim_boundary: SELF_GAUGE removes a common positive multiplicative coordinate choice for relative structure within one scene; it is not absolute radiometry and does not enlarge captured evidence.
zero_line_v0_2_latent_binding.next: v0.3 dense uncertainty field: measured CFA sensor/noise/PTC uncertainty + reconstructed-channel v5.0g bands, then covariance-aware colorimetric propagation.

zero_line_v0_3_dense_uncertainty.dense_field: 3 x width x height marginal uncertainty entries in exact v0.2 Latent Camera Scene scale

measured_cfa.model: DNG NoiseProfile Gaussian-equivalent marginal bands transformed consistently to Stage-2

reconstructed_channels.method: local maximum transport from same-color v5.0g anchors admitted only on physically measured CFA-role sites

zero_line_v0_3_dense_uncertainty.claim_boundary: Dense numeric uncertainty exists, but reconstructed-channel values remain transported backend proxies until missing-channel topology is independently validated. No RGB independence/covariance claim and no physical electron/PTC claim.

real_evidence_storage.integrity_policy: CI decompresses and verifies the original JSON bytes; compression is packaging only.
